In a fictional village called Sonapur, a mobile library began visiting in March 2024. The librarian, Rupa, carries books in a small van. Every Tuesday she parks beside the community centre. Rupa also reads aloud to younger children, who are not yet ready to read alone. The library brings stories closer to families who live far from a public library.

d) The books may be kept for a month.
e) A youth group helps repair covers.
